books.coreIdea: You are stronger than your changing feelings.
Do the right thing and do your best.
Wisdom helps us make better choices.
You can do good things without always thinking about yourself.
Your mind can become your friend.
The world is more connected than it looks.
Goodness and love can be found everywhere.
Look closely at the wonders around you.
You are part of something much bigger.
Notice what is happening inside you.
Different moods can pull us in different directions.
Every day, we can choose what kind of person we want to become.
Our habits shape who we become.
Understand yourself, make wise choices, and do what is right.
